sourceVisualNotes: Six actual inventory icons viewed: coral red butterfly with white pearl pattern; pale comma-shaped surprised ghost; silver microphone with colored music notes; gold/red command banner on pole; blue heart mobile phone with ring glyph; pink heart mobile phone with blue ring glyph. Phone signal glyphs and music notes are intentional parts of these item concepts, not ambient backgrounds.

items.name: coral-pearl-butterfly
items.designBrief: One coral RED butterfly hairpin in a gentle diagonal three-quarter view: FOUR rounded wings, ivory pearl spots on red lacquer, slender gold body and two tiny antennae, restrained jade center bead. Complete clear butterfly silhouette, no flowers/person/halo.

items.name: ivory-sigh-spirit
items.designBrief: One small friendly pale IVORY/CYAN comma-shaped sigh spirit charm: rounded large head and curving tapered tail, exactly two small jade eyes and a little open O mouth, one tiny side wisp. Hand-painted translucent cloud material with a fine gold forehead curl, our original simple spirit face, not any QQ mascot. NO aura or background.

items.name: jade-song-microphone
items.designBrief: One handheld MICROPHONE diagonally tilted: rounded silver mesh head, short darkjade handle, ivory/gold collar and small coral ribbon. Exactly THREE small isolated colored music notes around the microphone, clearly grouped inside this cell; all notes and full handle complete, no background glow, no person.

items.name: gold-command-banner
items.designBrief: One miniature vertical command BANNER on a slender complete darkwood pole with gold spear finial. Warmgold/ivory cloth, crimson border and short side streamers; exact centered single black Chinese character 令, no other writing or symbols. Full pole tip and lower end inside cell, legible banner face, jade cord knot.

items.name: blue-heart-call-phone
items.designBrief: One compact BLUE/Jade old-style candybar mobile PHONE, straight-on slightly tilted, little antenna, ivory keypad with clear simple round buttons, ivory screen showing one pink HEART. Two small warmgold curved ring-signal marks above phone, grouped contained item details; no letters or numbers, no ambient glow.

items.name: pink-heart-call-phone
items.designBrief: One compact PINK old-style candybar mobile PHONE, mirrored gentle tilt compared with blue phone, little antenna, ivory keypad with clear simple round buttons, ivory screen showing one red HEART. Two small cyan/jade curved ring-signal marks above phone, grouped contained item details. Fine gold rims, no letters/numbers or background.
